description: This Java source file defines a REST controller named RouteController for handling HTTP requests related to routes in the NeuroFleetX backend. It provides an endpoint for optimizing routes based on client requests.

classes.name: RouteController
classes.description: A Spring REST controller for route-related operations, including optimizing routes via the /route/optimize endpoint using POST requests.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Handles POST requests to /route/optimize; invokes routeService to obtain an optimized route based on the request payload.
